integrity: The proof is symbolic and reduces reversal of factors to an exact local condition on the first differences, which are 1 minus the 2-adic valuation of the next index modulo ell. A standalone verifier stress-tests the difference identity, the local obstruction, and observed factor languages over multiple moduli.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers digit-sum-modulo-ell generalized Thue--Morse words for ell at least 3. It does not give a closed formula for their factor complexity and does not cover the ordinary binary case.
title: Reflection complexity equals factor complexity for generalized Thue--Morse words modulo \(\ell\ge3\)
